_help: Edit the prompt templates and rules here. Placeholders: {article} {ethnicity} {person} {gender} {clothing}. {person} is the age+gender phrase from 'person' below. Lookups that depend on gender use the gender's CLASS (see gender_class), so androgyne uses the female wording for age words and clothing.

ethnicities._help: file tag : word used in the prompt. 'All' uses this list. Add new groups here, or just type a new name when you run the tool.

defaults.headgear: an olive Peaked Cap with a red star on it

_ethnic_rules_help: Extra wording per ethnic group, merged in the order listed. 'ethnicities' = file tags. 'classes' (optional) = genders or gender classes it applies to; androgyne counts as female. 'ages' (optional) = ages it applies to. 'negative' = text sent in the generator's hidden NEGATIVE PROMPT (things the image must not contain); several rules are joined with commas.'head' goes right after the age/gender phrase (before the clothing); 'headgear' replaces {headgear} (the cap in uniform prompts); both can be a text or {category: text, 'default': text}. 'suffix' is added at the very end of the prompt and can be {gender or class: text, 'default': text}.

ethnic_rules.name: Arab and Indian females and androgynes: uncovered, visible hair, no head covering
ethnic_rules.head: with uncovered hair,

ethnic_rules.name: Sikh, young and older, all genders: turban (in uniform prompts it replaces the cap)

headgear.uniform: an olive turban with a red star on it

ethnic_rules.name: Sikh children and teens: no turban

street.template: Sci-fi setting. Frontal close-up passport photo of the face of a content {ethnicity} {person}{head} with an sleeveless shirt and a jacket. The background is a sci-fi street at night.{suffix}

hydroponic.template: Sci-fi setting. Frontal close-up passport photo of the face of a content {ethnicity} {person}{head} with {clothing}. The background is a lavish hydroponic garden.{suffix}

uniform.template: Frontal close-up passport photo of the face of {article} {ethnicity} {person}{head} with {headgear} and a Soviet style uniform. The background is futuristic, but with no windows.{suffix}
